title: RDS Instance Failure – Diagnosis and Recovery
description: Step-by-step RDS recovery. Each step refers to a diagnostic file in S3 to classify the failure before acting.

decision_tree.name: Classify RDS failure type
decision_tree.instruction: Read the RDS event message and match against the failure classification guide to determine failure category.

conditions.note: Failover already in progress, monitor only

decision_tree.name: Check if Multi-AZ is enabled before rebooting
decision_tree.instruction: If Multi-AZ is enabled, reboot with failover to avoid downtime. If single-AZ, standard reboot causes ~60s outage.

conditions.note: Single-AZ reboot causes downtime – confirm with team

decision_tree.name: Verify connectivity after reboot
decision_tree.instruction: After reboot, verify instance status is Available and application can connect within 3 minutes.

conditions.note: DB up but app cannot connect – check security groups
DB did not recover – engage AWS Support

feedback_notes: Connection exhaustion most common cause. Multi-AZ failover reboot is zero-downtime.
